title: POV: You Found a Crypto Startup (Billion or Zero)
hook: Federal agents are carrying your servers out in evidence bags. A monitor behind them still glows: WALLET FROZEN, $1.4 billion. Three hundred forty days ago you had $4,200 and an idea in a garage. This is how you got here — and what it actually costs.
body: POV: you're a first-time founder who quits with $4,200 in savings, raises a seed round on a SAFT, and launches a token that becomes one of only 3 out of 56 VC-backed tokens to cross a $1 billion market cap in 2025 — before a treasury exploit drains $620 million in eleven minutes and the market cap craters 91% in a single day. Real, verified mechanics woven in: the actual 2025 base rate that only 3 of 56 VC-backed crypto launches ever crossed $1B FDV (most launch underwater) — the real math behind 'billion or zero.' The real March-2022 Ronin/Axie Infinity bridge hack ($625M stolen via compromised multisig keys, later attributed to the Lazarus Group) as the model for this episode's exploit. The real May-2022 Terra/Luna collapse (~$40-45B erased in about three days after Terraform Labs burned its own reserves defending the peg) as the model for this founder's own crossed line. Do Kwon's real December-2025 sentence — 15 years — for that collapse, referenced by name. Real SAFT/vesting mechanics, real SEC Wells notice procedure. A dramatized cautionary POV — the founder, the company, and the token are a fictional composite; the market data, the Ronin hack, the Terra collapse, and the Do Kwon sentencing are real and independently documented. Watch the whole series — every life, every level, every way the number costs you. For educational and entertainment purposes.
pinned: Real number: only 3 of the 56 VC-backed crypto tokens that launched in 2025 ever crossed a $1 billion market cap. That's not a slogan — that's the actual math behind 'billion or zero.' Which level do you think ends the most founders: the launch, or the exploit?
poll: Which level breaks you first? LEVEL 02 (the seed, giving up 18%) / LEVEL 05 (the $1.4B peak, paper-rich) / LEVEL 06 (the treasury drained in 11 minutes) / LEVEL 07 (the SEC Wells notice)
